ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer has no minimum purchase commitment and will pay only for Services used or ordered under an Order Form during the applicable term.

input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment, as our playbook does not permit multi-year minimum commitments with no reduction or termination right; this also aligns § 2.1 with the convenience-termination right in § 9.4 and the no-minimum-volume acknowledgement in § 12.3. If a commitment is commercially essential, we can accept one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and settled by true-up rather than penalty.
input.summary: Delete take-or-pay commitment; pay only for Services used or ordered.
